title: Divide decimals
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings, word problems, and an 'is this right?' item. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation behind the item, used only by the test that checks the answer key. No item needs long division: after moving the decimal point, every division is a basic fact.
directions: Show your work. When you divide by a decimal, show how you moved the decimal point.

items.prompt: A $7.20 bill is split equally among 6 friends. How much does each person pay?
A board 1.2 m long is cut into pieces 0.2 m long. Kim says 1.2 ÷ 0.2 = 0.6, so there are 0.6 pieces. Is she right? Explain, and give the correct answer.
items.answer: 6 (No: count how many 0.2s fit in 1.2; that is 12 ÷ 2 = 6 pieces)

items.prompt: A bag of dog food holds 5.4 kg. Each scoop is 0.6 kg. How many scoops are in the bag?
Jon says 3.5 ÷ 7 = 2, because 7 ÷ 3.5 = 2. Is he right? Explain, and give the correct answer.
items.answer: 0.5 (No: order matters in division; 3.5 ÷ 7 shares 3.5 into 7 parts, and 35 tenths ÷ 7 = 5 tenths)
